name: Default multi-lens
description: Full F52 seven-lens pass for general code PRs.

lenses.hint: regressions, edge cases, wrong defaults, off-by-one, null/empty paths
injection, authz, secrets, XSS, unsafe deserialize, SSRF
risky production paths covered? claim-to-fix without tests?
N+1, unbounded loops, cache misuse, heavy work on hot path (only if evidence)
public API / payload / RPC / ORM field contract breaks
races, double-submit, lock order (only if concurrent surface)
only if it causes real future defect risk (not style laundry)
